 Tip of the Day: Liverpool and Chelsea to pile misery on strugglers, Brighton to go second
 Sunday's Tip of the Day features Liverpool and Chelsea going against Premier League strugglers.
 Nicholas McGee 
 • 
 Last Update:
 56 minutes ago
 • 
 2 min read
 It’s an action-packed Premier League Sunday, providing plenty of options for the Tip of the Day.
 There are five games in England’s top flight before it pauses for the international break and, for our treble, we’ve gone for the games involving Liverpool , Chelsea and Brighton and Hove Albion .
 Liverpool visit struggling Crystal Palace and are heavy favourites to take all three points at Selhurst Park.
 Palace are winless in their last seven games in all competitions, with a clash with Liverpool far from an ideal fixture three days on from their Europa League draw with Hoffenheim.
 The Reds will be desperate to bounce back from successive defeats to Arsenal and Fenerbahce, and we’re backing them to do just that and pile even more pressure on Pierre Sage.
 Chelsea face another side at the wrong end of the table as they travel to rock bottom Sunderland.
 The Black Cats were hugely disappointing on Thursday as they slumped to a 2-0 home defeat to Dinamo Zagreb.
 While Chelsea have had their problems defensively, the attacking talent they have at their disposal should be enough for them to make it another miserable afternoon for Regis Le Bris’ men.
 The final leg of our treble takes us to the south coast, where Brighton host Brentford.
 Fabian Hurzeler’s men can go second with a win after Manchester City’s loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday and, against an inconsistent Brentford side, we’re making a Seagulls victory the third leg of our treble.
